limitations: One complete original generic whole apple. One type only; no cultivar, color, size, cut section, peeled or separate stem variants counted. No old food, tool, apple peeler or plant components copied or extracted.

Single explicitly closed connected exterior: rounded shoulders with subtle lobing, depressed upper stem seat, gently curved short woody stem and generalized closed bottom. The stem shares its root ring with the body, without a separately penetrating stem, overlapping contact faces or an internal duplicate sphere.

Three decreasing LODs in BLEND/GLB/FBX, nine actual reimports and35renders. Unlabeled128px oblique views judged apple-like from short stem, recessed stem seat and rounded shoulders rather than a plain colored sphere. Assistant judgment, not audience test or game-engine verification.
Valid per-face planar UVs overlap intentionally; not a unique packed bake atlas. Plain original materials without source textures, photograph pixels, labels or copied graphics.
